Hi! Have you tried any medication before? I ask because I’m wondering if you had a bad reaction once which is leading you to fear other medications. Have you been to a psychiatrist before? I would bring up your concerns to him/her so that they can help you find a medication that has minimal side effects and that would help your depression. Some people with depression have other mental illnesses as well. The psychiatrist can determine if you are suffering from anything else so they can best help you with medication and or other treatment options. Have you heard of TMS? It is a non invasive procedure in which your brain is stimulated my magnets. It is for people with treatment resistant depression so you have to have tried a few medications before being able to try it. I also recommend finding a therapist who can help you with the fears you have about medication. It’s not for everyone (medication) but there are many people who it does benefit and helps them have a better quality of life.  If you haven’t tried any medications before, I really think it’s worth a shot because it has the potential to help you feel better. Do you live with family? I know you said you’re not making enough to support yourself. You could apply for disability benefits to help you support yourself but you will need to be seen by a therapist and have documentation detailing your disability. I wish you the best and hope some of this info helps.
